testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, input, tab, card, and key text element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use generic light or bright white templates. Strictly execute the Bold Dark Futuristic aesthetic.
Do NOT use pure #000000 flat color everywhere. Tint neutrals with cool navy/dark indigo (#06060A, #0D0E15).
Ensure all contrast ratios exceed WCAG AA standards: Body text should be light silver (#94A3B8 or #F8FAFC) against dark containers.
DO NOT use transparent header without backdrop-blur. The navbar must use glassmorphism with z-50.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations, hover states, accordion transitions, and horizontal scrolling.
All interactive components must have data-testid attributes.
Make sure all 7 core services specified in the user prompt are prominently displayed and filterable/expandable.
Contact info for Founder Dhimant S Reddy (sdhim8055@gmail.com, +91 6361751228) must be easily readable and functional with one-click copy/mailto.
